Bill.BriefDescription: Relating to fees to implement programs that protect and improve Washington's health, safety, education, employees, and consumers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to fees to implement programs that protect andimprove Washington's health, safety, education, employees, andconsumers.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: To protect taxpayers, many state programsrequire the costs of licensing, registration, certification, andrelated government services to be borne by the profession or industrythat uses the services, rather than by the taxpaying public as a whole.State standards that govern the professional duties of these industriesare intended to protect the general public by safeguarding health,safety, employees, and consumers. Similarly, state higher educationprograms require a portion of their costs to be shared by thoseparticipating in them. The legislative approval of the fees and feeincreases in this act is intended to ensure that the general public isnot assessed these costs while also providing adequate funding tostatutory programs that safeguard and improve Washington's health,safety, education, employees, and consumers.
